title: Ghost update
body: I recently received an email notice that mp3guessenc had been updated. https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/mp3guessenc Seems it was updated by tippfehlr on 12th June. But there are no recent commits! https://aur.archlinux.org/cgit/aur.git/ … p3guessenc Whats actually been updated then? ( tippfehlr is not listed as a maintainer for this package. ) I have no idea if this is related to the current malware issue, but the timing seems suspicious. Cheers, Peter
